description: Gave six days as nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose, and would not read them aloud.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Set dinner at sixpence, and sent the rest of the talk home.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Took six-and-thirty without asking it to be forty, and went home.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Priced the glass at four shillings, and stayed gloomy about giants without naming a Rose sum.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked for the break, and closed his hand as on a handle.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the sum, refused an average, and went home.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Told the glass, refused to buy it tonight, and kept the book unshown.
name: William Shakespeare
